use_when.text: Use Privacy where people share ownership details, such as the claim form, to say who can see them.
Use AI Match when the system suggests a possible match, so people know to check it.
Write the title as one short statement, and the body as one sentence of detail.
Set the width to Fill so it adapts to mobile and the public website.
Place it just above the content it explains.

dont_use_when.text: Do not use it for form errors. Use the Input Error state.
Do not stack more than one callout in a row.
Do not put buttons or links inside it. Put the action next to it.
Do not make it narrower than 288.
Do not recolour it outside the bound tokens.

best_practice.text: Keep both lines short, so the callout stays one or two lines tall on mobile.
Use the same type for the same message across screens, so people learn what each colour means.

variant_intent.intent: Use Privacy where people share ownership details, such as the claim form, to say who can see them.

placement.text: Dialog Box, between the body and the actions row, Privacy by default; off with ShowCallout.
